brief: 310m Menara Telekom with two separately curved and tapered office wings, central core,22 planted open sky gardens, bowed cyan transfer trusses, recessed ribbon glazing with three metal sunshade blades, clad antenna sail and the236m bowl-supported helipad.

reconstruction.plan: Gabor/Gurusamy1997 Figure1 and Figure3 establish two opposing16m curved office strips and rectangular core; the map roof projection is retained as evidence, not extruded into an incorrect solid.
reconstruction.facade: Primary HIJJAS elevation and completed photographs control the curved taper, repeated recessed glass ribbons, three projecting louver blades, ACP end walls, garden bowstrings and helipad bowl. Intermediate module dimensions are photo reconstruction.

limitations: Original buildTelekom remains unchanged and reproduces1458078triangles/127149832bytes. Independent reviewed source preserves both separate curved/tapering16m office strips, central closed core, all22 open triangular sky gardens, cyan bowstring trusses, planted terraces, separate310m clad antenna sail/TM strokes and236m six-level helipad bowl. Original3.5m facade course rhythm is reconstructed, not a literal55-floor count. Near16segments replace56curve segments; continuous recessed glass ribbons and projected flat sunshade leading edges replace repeated closed beam shells. Three sampled shade strips per course approximate original four blade edges. End walls retain continuous ribbon glazing without narrow original mullions. Garden plants use simple faceted shrub masses/eight three-segment fronds, not individual pinnae. Two-sided vertical strip trusses approximate solid steel profiles; they remain visibly open, not filled walls. Helipad72sides/open radial fall-protection grating/four concentric strips and landing H/ring replace144sides/round torus tubes; ground portal retained. Skyline omits portal, glass detail, truss/guard profiles, palms, heli ring/grating and TM glyph, but keeps22 open garden slabs/green strips, distinct curved wings, closed core,12-sided bowl/disk/H and310m piers. District restores portal, ribbon glazing, TM strokes,16-sided open heli grating and two-segment bowstrings; street restores7m coarse courses, four-segment bowstrings/two-frond palms and32-sided helipad. Close-up restores3.5m courses/flat mullions/shade strips,12-segment bowstrings/guards/eight-frond palms,72-sided helipad/ribs. Original wing curves and independent heli center retained; canopy, lower-wing feet, taper, garden levels/planting and intermediate modules are reconstructed. Painted-metal graph approximates ACP; vertex-tinted shared granite approximates paving, shrubs and trunks within draw budget; opaque palette approximates glass and translucent palette vestibule side walls. Physical-device/dense-city timings, curb survey and global geometric error bounds unmeasured.
